modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow appropriate safety practices while working in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas
lift heavy objects safely using correct procedures
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person

modules.module_title: Emergencies, rescue and first aid procedures

pcs.pc_description: use appropriate type of fire extinguisher
apply appropriate rescue techniques during fire hazard
provide appropriate first aid procedure to victims wherever required eg.in case of bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock etc.
follow emergency procedures such as raising alarm, safe evacuation etc.
attend safety training and fire drills to respond promptly during an emergency
follow regular cleaning and disinfection practices at work place using appropriate techniques and materials
follow hand hygiene practices at work place using appropriate techniques and materials
report regarding the contagious illness of self or people in close contact
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
follow the fundamentals of 5S for housekeeping
ensure good housekeeping in order to prevent hazards and accidents
store the material, tools and equipment in the correct location and in good condition
segregate waste into different categories
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Perform installation of machine/electrical panels and its components

pcs.pc_description: prepare the foundation base as per the job requirements i.e. cleaning using hand files, scraper, etc.
lift the machine/electrical panels manually or by hoist and place the same securely on the designated place as indicated in the drawing/work instructions
use braces, jacks, clamps, ropes or bolt straps to hold parts in position
prepare control cables, electrical components like MCB’s, contactors, relays etc. as per drawing requirement
mount, align and level all attachments and fixtures on machine/electrical panels by using hand tools and precision measuring instruments
perform assembly operations and assemble all the parts of machine/electrical panels as mentioned in drawing/blueprint
use tools such as saws, cutting torches, pipe threaders or benders to cut, thread or bend parts as per the specifications
fasten the mechanical components/ subassemblies together by using specified screws, bolts, and collars
set and adjust the linkages, tensions and clearances of assembled components to specified specifications by using fixed gauges and hand tools
use wires strippers, crippling tool and other insulated tools for making the electrical connections of machine/electrical panels
follow the do's and don’ts of the manufacturing process as defined in SOPs/Work Instructions or given by supervisors
escalate the problems faced during installation and assembly activities to the supervisor

modules.module_title: Conduct tests to ensure fitness of equipment

pcs.pc_description: check the machine/electrical panels component as per the control plan, WI for proper working
set the test apparatus as per the selected testing process and SOPs/WI
connect the machine/electrical panels and its components, various data capturing meters and gauges with the testing apparatus as per SOP/WI
conduct functional tests of assembled machine/electrical panels to ensure it performs as per desired performance criteria
identify non-conformities and their causes to quality assurance standards
record observations/ readings as per the parameters mentioned in the testing manual/Work Instructions
observe any deviation, noise or vibrations during the testing process and change or repair the machine/electrical panels components as per the requirement
conduct trials of the equipment to ensure that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities
record the test and trial results as per the organisation guidelines
suggest and implement the corrective actions to address problems in machine/electric panels
record adjustments not covered by established procedures for future reference
add lubricants and coolants into moving parts of machine as per SOP/WI
clean and store all the tools, machine and equipment after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process
maintain and update all the records and reports related to assembling activities done as per the organisational guidelines
